trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Scientist (Generic)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T041 must not be allowed to test prototypes on live SCPs without Level-3 approval.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T041 is a research specialist capable of designing experimental containment tools with anomalous efficiency. Devices created by SCP-T041 often function beyond expected parameters.
trainer_scp.behavior_notes: Focused, obsessive, and prone to overwork.
addendum_logs: Addendum T041-A: SCP-T041’s prototype neutralized SCP-0100 (Voltorb) detonation risk for 48 hours.
Addendum T041-B: SCP-T041 predicted a structural failure in SCP-0076’s vault 12 minutes before sensors detected it.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Engineer (Power Plant)
abilities: rapid repair of EM containment systems
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T042 may assist in maintaining Faraday vaults. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T042 to SCP-0145 (Zapdos).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T042 is an engineer specializing in high-voltage anomalous systems. Displays mild resistance to electrical shocks and exceptional repair speed.
addendum_logs: Addendum T042-A: SCP-T042 restored power after SCP-0125 (Electabuzz) caused a blackout.
Addendum T042-B: SCP-T042 stabilized EM fluctuations caused by SCP-0082 (Magneton).

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Fisherman
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T043 must not be allowed near SCP-0130 (Gyarados) without escort.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T043 displays anomalous ability to detect aquatic anomalies at long distances. Frequently interacts with SCP-0116 (Horsea) and SCP-0098 (Krabby).
addendum_logs: Addendum T043-A: SCP-T043 detected SCP-0130 approaching 2 km before sensors.
Addendum T043-B: SCP-T043 resisted SCP-0117 (Seadra)’s venomous spine attack.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Bug Catcher
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T044 may assist with low-threat bug-type anomalies. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T044 to SCP-0049 (Venomoth).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T044 displays anomalous affinity for insectoid SCP entities and can handle them safely. Shows mild toxin resistance.
addendum_logs: Addendum T044-A: SCP-T044 safely captured SCP-0010 (Caterpie) during a breach.
Addendum T044-B: SCP-T044 resisted SCP-0048 (Beedrill)’s mild toxin.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Bird Keeper
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T045 must not be allowed near SCP-0142 (Aerodactyl) or SCP-0146 (Moltres).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T045 displays anomalous coordination with avian SCP entities, allowing safe interaction with mid-threat flying anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T045-A: SCP-T045 synchronized flight patterns with SCP-0016 (Pidgeotto).
Addendum T045-B: SCP-T045 survived a fall from 30 meters with minor injuries.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Gambler
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T046 near volatile SCPs. All interactions require probability dampeners.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T046 displays uncontrolled probability distortion, causing unpredictable outcomes in nearby systems. Effects intensify during emotional stress.
addendum_logs: Addendum T046-A: SCP-T046 caused three simultaneous low-probability events during testing.
Addendum T046-B: SCP-0100 (Voltorb) detonated prematurely during SCP-T046’s presence.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Psychic (Saffron)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must maintain cognitive shielding. SCP-T047 must not be exposed to SCP-T009 (Sabrina).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T047 displays mild psychic abilities, including weak telepathy and limited telekinesis. Capabilities fluctuate based on emotional state.
addendum_logs: Addendum T047-A: SCP-T047 predicted a minor containment breach 3 minutes before occurrence.
Addendum T047-B: SCP-T047 fainted after brief exposure to SCP-0065 (Alakazam).

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Medium (Lavender)
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T048 to SCP-0094 (Gengar) due to risk of psychic overload.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T048 displays anomalous sensitivity to spectral SCP entities and can detect ectoplasmic residue invisible to sensors.
addendum_logs: Addendum T048-A: SCP-T048 detected SCP-0092 (Gastly) before sensors registered its presence.
Addendum T048-B: SCP-T048 entered a trance state near SCP-0093 (Haunter).

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Sailor
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: SCP-T049 may assist in maritime SCP containment. Personnel must avoid exposing SCP-T049 to SCP-0130 (Gyarados).
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T049 displays anomalous resilience to maritime hazards and can operate safely in unstable aquatic environments.
addendum_logs: Addendum T049-A: SCP-T049 stabilized a containment raft during SCP-0116’s agitation.
Addendum T049-B: SCP-T049 resisted SCP-0117 (Seadra)’s hydrokinesis blast.

trainer_scp.name: Pokémon Gentleman
trainer_scp.containment_advisories: Personnel must avoid allowing SCP-T050 to negotiate with hostile anomalies.
trainer_scp.description: SCP-T050 displays anomalous charisma capable of influencing docile SCP entities and calming low-threat anomalies.
addendum_logs: Addendum T050-A: SCP-T050 convinced SCP-0058 (Growlithe) to release a guard unharmed.
Addendum T050-B: SCP-0077 (Ponyta) displayed reduced flame output in SCP-T050’s presence.
